title: Keep trade document line editing bound to the selected document during asynchronous actions
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Bind each load/save/delete operation to captured document/dialog generation and editing identity. Switching documents, closing, reopening or a newer reload must make old responses unable to replace current data, clear input, trigger incorrect reload or show stale action success. Save/delete payload IDs must be captured from current authorized loaded document before asynchronous confirmation or request. Prevent duplicate mutation submissions, preserve unsaved input on failure and correctly refresh only the still active successful document. Do not invent client authority, bypass server permissions/status or recalculate amount.

Executable JS tests with deferred mocked responses for A-to-B switch, out-of-order reload, close/reopen same ID, edit while save pending, confirmation switch, failed mutation and duplicate click; assertions verify exact API document/item IDs, no stale rendering/input loss, valid successful reload, quantity/optional weight and backend-computed amount semantics preserved. Run existing line UI checks and safe Release/full unit suite; real browser evidence or accurate blocker. No style-only work.

implementation_evidence: trade-doc-items.js stores global TDI.docId/data/editing. tdiReload assigns an awaited old response directly to current global state. Save/delete await then clear current editing and reload, so switching documents during requests can render the old document or erase unrelated unsaved form input. Existing UI is functional and requires request identity and action ownership.
